apiDocs.binotelAboutDesc: Binotel is a Ukrainian cloud PBX platform. When you enable the webhook integration, Binotel automatically notifies this system after every completed call. The recording is downloaded, transcribed, and AI-analyzed — no manual uploads needed.
apiDocs.binotelHowStep1: Binotel sends a POST request to your webhook URL after each call.
apiDocs.binotelHowStep2: We validate your API key and skip unanswered calls automatically.
apiDocs.binotelHowStep3: The recording file is downloaded from Binotel's servers.
apiDocs.binotelHowStep4: Analysis starts immediately — results appear in your dashboard within minutes.
apiDocs.binotelHowStep5: The audio file is deleted from our server as soon as analysis is complete.
apiDocs.binotelStep1Desc: Enter your API key below to build your personal webhook URL. You will paste this URL into the Binotel admin panel in Step 2.
apiDocs.binotelStep2Desc: Log in to your Binotel account and follow these steps:
apiDocs.binotelSetupStep1: Open the Binotel cabinet → Settings → Integrations → "External webhooks" (Зовнішні вебхуки).
apiDocs.binotelSetupStep2: Click "Add webhook" and paste your webhook URL from Step 1.
apiDocs.binotelSetupStep3: Set the event to "End of call" (Завершення дзвінка).
apiDocs.binotelSetupStep4: Make sure "Send recording URL" (Надсилати URL запису) is enabled.
apiDocs.binotelSetupStep5: Save and make a test call to verify.
apiDocs.binotelEndpointDesc: Binotel calls this endpoint after each completed call. Authenticate via query param — no Authorization header needed.
apiDocs.binotelPayloadDesc: Binotel sends a JSON body similar to this. Only answered calls (disposition: "ANSWERED") are processed; the rest are silently skipped.
apiDocs.binotelPayloadNoteA: The recording URL may appear as
apiDocs.binotelResponseDescA: On success the endpoint returns the queued call ID. Poll
apiDocs.binotelPayloadNote: The recording URL may appear as 'file', 'file_url', or 'record_url' — all variants are handled automatically.
apiDocs.integrationHowStep2: We validate your API key and skip unanswered calls automatically.
apiDocs.integrationHowStep4: Analysis starts immediately — results appear in your dashboard within minutes.
apiDocs.integrationHowStep5: The audio file is deleted from our server as soon as analysis is complete.
apiDocs.integrationStep1Desc: Enter your API key below to build your personal webhook URL. Paste this URL into your platform's webhook settings.
apiDocs.integrationResponseDescA: On success the endpoint returns the queued call ID. Poll
apiDocs.keycrmAboutDesc: KeyCRM is a Ukrainian CRM platform with built-in telephony. When a call ends, KeyCRM sends a webhook with the recording URL which is automatically downloaded and analyzed.
apiDocs.keycrmHowStep1: KeyCRM sends a POST request to your webhook URL after each completed call.
apiDocs.keycrmHowStep3: The recording file is downloaded from KeyCRM's servers.
apiDocs.keycrmStep2Desc: Log in to your KeyCRM account and navigate to the webhook settings:
apiDocs.keycrmSetupStep2: Click “Add webhook” and paste your webhook URL from Step 1.
apiDocs.keycrmSetupStep3: Set the trigger event to “Call completed” (call.completed).
apiDocs.keycrmSetupStep4: Ensure recording URLs are included in the payload and save.
apiDocs.keycrmEndpointDesc: KeyCRM calls this endpoint after each completed call. Authenticate via query param — no Authorization header needed.
apiDocs.keycrmPayloadDesc: KeyCRM sends a JSON body with call data nested under a ‘data’ key. Only answered calls are processed.
apiDocs.keycrmPayloadNote: The recording URL appears as data.recording_url. Alternatives data.record_url and data.file are also supported.
apiDocs.ringostatAboutDesc: Ringostat is a call-tracking and telephony platform. The webhook integration automatically forwards call recordings for AI analysis after each completed call.
apiDocs.ringostatHowStep1: Ringostat sends a POST request to your webhook URL after each call ends.
apiDocs.ringostatHowStep3: The recording file is downloaded from Ringostat's servers.
apiDocs.ringostatStep2Desc: Log in to your Ringostat account and set up the webhook:
apiDocs.ringostatSetupStep2: Create a new webhook and paste your URL from Step 1.
apiDocs.ringostatSetupStep3: Set the trigger to the “Call ended” event.
apiDocs.ringostatSetupStep4: Enable the recording URL in the payload and save.
apiDocs.ringostatEndpointDesc: Ringostat calls this endpoint after each call ends. Authenticate via query param — no Authorization header needed.
apiDocs.ringostatPayloadDesc: Ringostat sends a JSON body with call details. Only answered calls are processed.
apiDocs.ringostatPayloadNote: The recording URL appears as recordFile. Alternatives record_url and file are also supported.
apiDocs.kyivstarAboutDesc: Kyivstar Business Cloud PBX is a Ukrainian enterprise telephony platform. Webhook events are sent after each call completes, enabling automatic recording analysis.
apiDocs.kyivstarHowStep1: Kyivstar Cloud PBX sends a POST request to your webhook URL after each call.
apiDocs.kyivstarHowStep3: The recording file is downloaded from Kyivstar's servers.
apiDocs.kyivstarStep2Desc: Log in to your Kyivstar Business account and configure webhooks:
apiDocs.kyivstarSetupStep1: Open your Kyivstar Cloud PBX admin panel → Integrations → Webhooks.
apiDocs.kyivstarSetupStep2: Add a new webhook and paste your URL from Step 1.
apiDocs.kyivstarSetupStep4: Confirm that recording URLs are included in the payload and save.
apiDocs.kyivstarEndpointDesc: Kyivstar calls this endpoint after each completed call. Authenticate via query param — no Authorization header needed.
apiDocs.kyivstarPayloadDesc: Kyivstar sends a JSON body with call details. Only answered calls are processed.
apiDocs.kyivstarPayloadNote: The recording URL appears as recording_url. The alternative field record_url is also supported.
apiDocs.voiptimeAboutDesc: VoIPTime Cloud is a contact-center and cloud telephony platform. After each answered call, it sends a webhook that triggers automatic recording analysis.
apiDocs.voiptimeHowStep1: VoIPTime Cloud sends a POST request to your webhook URL after each call.
apiDocs.voiptimeHowStep3: The recording file is downloaded from VoIPTime's servers.
apiDocs.voiptimeStep2Desc: Log in to your VoIPTime Cloud account and configure webhook notifications:
apiDocs.voiptimeSetupStep1: Open VoIPTime Cloud → Settings → Notifications → Webhooks.
apiDocs.voiptimeSetupStep2: Click “Add” and paste your webhook URL from Step 1.
apiDocs.voiptimeSetupStep4: Make sure recording URLs are included in the notification and save.
apiDocs.voiptimeEndpointDesc: VoIPTime calls this endpoint after each call ends. Authenticate via query param — no Authorization header needed.
apiDocs.voiptimePayloadDesc: VoIPTime sends a JSON body with call data nested under a ‘call’ key. Only answered calls are processed.
apiDocs.voiptimePayloadNote: The recording URL appears as call.record_url or call.recording_url. The field call.file is also supported.
apiDocs.twilioAboutDesc: Twilio is a global cloud communications platform. The Status Callback webhook is sent as form-encoded data after each call completes, enabling automatic recording analysis.
apiDocs.twilioHowStep1: Twilio sends a POST request (form-encoded) to your webhook URL when a call completes.
apiDocs.twilioHowStep3: The recording file is downloaded from Twilio's servers (.mp3 extension appended automatically).
apiDocs.twilioStep2Desc: Log in to the Twilio Console and set up the Status Callback URL:
apiDocs.twilioSetupStep1: Open Twilio Console → Phone Numbers → Manage → your number.
apiDocs.twilioSetupStep2: In the “Voice Configuration” section, find “Status Callback URL”.
apiDocs.twilioSetupStep3: Paste your webhook URL from Step 1 and set the method to POST.
apiDocs.twilioSetupStep4: Enable call recording for the number or in your TwiML, then save.
apiDocs.twilioEndpointDesc: Twilio calls this endpoint as form-encoded POST (not JSON) after each completed call. Authenticate via query param — no Authorization header needed.
apiDocs.twilioPayloadDesc: Twilio sends application/x-www-form-urlencoded data. Only completed calls (CallStatus=completed) are processed.
apiDocs.twilioPayloadNote: RecordingUrl is provided without a file extension — .mp3 is appended automatically.
apiDocs.twilioAuthNote: Security tip: for production deployments, also validate the X-Twilio-Signature header using your Auth Token to prevent spoofed requests.
apiDocs.aircallAboutDesc: Aircall is a cloud-based phone system for customer-facing teams. The call.ended webhook event is sent after each call, enabling automatic transcription and analysis of recordings.
apiDocs.aircallHowStep1: Aircall sends a call.ended event to your webhook URL after each call.
apiDocs.aircallHowStep3: The recording file is downloaded from Aircall's servers.
apiDocs.aircallStep2Desc: Log in to your Aircall Dashboard and configure the webhook integration:
apiDocs.aircallSetupStep1: Open Aircall Dashboard → Integrations → API & Webhooks.
apiDocs.aircallSetupStep2: Click “Create a webhook” and paste your URL from Step 1.
apiDocs.aircallSetupStep4: Save the webhook — Aircall will immediately start sending events.
apiDocs.aircallEndpointDesc: Aircall sends a call.ended event to this endpoint after each call. Authenticate via query param — no Authorization header needed.
apiDocs.aircallPayloadDesc: Aircall sends a JSON body with a ‘data’ object containing call details. Calls without a recording are automatically skipped.
apiDocs.aircallPayloadNote: The recording URL appears as data.recording. If it is null (missed or unanswered call), the event is silently skipped.
